abstract.t: This document describes the Namespace Identifier (NID) 'mplify' for Uniform Resource Names (URNs) used to identify resources published by Mplify Alliance. Mplify specifies and manages resources that utilize this URN identification model. This URN namespace will complement the existing "mef" URN namespace registered in RFC 7818. Management activities for these and other resource types are handled by the manager of the Mplify Assigned Names and Numbers (MANN) registry.

section.title: Introduction
section.t: Mplify Alliance (https://www.mplify.net/), formerly MEF Forum, is a global alliance of enterprises, service providers, cloud providers, data center operators, technology providers, and systems integrators, working together to accelerate the AI-powered digital economy through standardization, automation, certification, and collaboration.

Mplify is the defining body for Carrier Ethernet, Lifecycle Service Orchestration (LSO) APIs, and certified SASE and SD-WAN. Mplify has developed the global blueprint for Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) that is empowering the industry to innovate, interoperate, and scale trusted network services across a global ecosystem.

In June 2025, MEF Forum became Mplify Alliance. The "mplify" URN namespace is being registered to provide persistent, unique identifiers for resources published under the Mplify Alliance brand, complementing the existing "mef" URN namespace registered in URN Namespace for MEF Documents. To ensure that this namespace's uniqueness is absolute, a registration of a specific Unified Resource Name (URN) Uniform Resource Nmaes (URNs) Namespace Identifier (NID) for use by Mplify is being specified in this document.

The existing "mef" URN namespace remains valid. URNs previously assigned under "urn:mef:*" continue to be valid and will not be reassigned or retired. However, no new assignments will be made under ‘mef’. Any new resources will be assigned URNs under the "mplify" namespace. URNs under ‘mef’ and ‘mplify’ are distinct identifiers. No equivalence is implied between urn:mef:X and urn:mplify:X.

ul.li: Product schemas and product specification identifiers
Any other resources that require managed, persistent identification as part of Mplify Alliance activities

li.t: The existing "mef" URN namespace () remains valid. URNs previously assigned under "urn:mef:*" continue to be valid and will not be reassigned or retired. New resources will be assigned URNs under the "mplify" namespace.

ul.li: The syntax of namespace specific strings for the 'mplify' namespace is <NSS> in RFC 8141.
Assignment of a URN from the Mplify namespace will be documented as part of the Mplify Assigned Names and Numbers (MANN) registry.

li.t: There are no additional security considerations other than those normally associated with the use and resolution of URNs in general, which are described in .

URNs in the "mplify" namespace identify publicly available specifications, data models, and related resources. These URNs do not themselves contain or expose private or personally identifiable information.
Since the "mplify" namespace assigns URNs to publicly available resources, directory harvesting is not a significant concern.
Mplify Alliance does not assign URNs based on information that could be used to track individuals or compromise privacy.
The "mplify" namespace coexists with the "mef" namespace registered in . URNs previously assigned under "urn:mef:*" remain valid and are unaffected by this registration.

Mplify Alliance will maintain clear documentation in the MANN registry (https://www.mplify.net/MANN/) to distinguish resources identified under the "mplify" namespace from those under the legacy "mef" namespace, avoiding ambiguity.

Where a resource was originally identified by a "urn:mef:*" URN, that URN will not be reassigned or duplicated under "urn:mplify:*" unless explicitly documented as an equivalence mapping in the MANN registry.
The hierarchical NSS structure is designed to avoid conflicts with other URN namespaces, URI schemes, and non-URN identifier systems.

ul.li: The namespace is not listed with a Resolution Discovery System (RDS). Therefore this process is not relevant.
Mplify publishes information regarding the registered resources in the Mplify Assigned Names and Numbers (MANN) registry (https://www.mplify.net/MANN).

li.t: Mplify Alliance (formerly MEF Forum) rebranded in June 2025.

The "mef" URN namespace () was registered when the organization was known as MEF Forum. The "mplify" namespace is registered to reflect the new organizational identity while preserving the validity and persistence of all existing "urn:mef:*" assignments.
The MANN registry (https://www.mplify.net/MANN/) serves as the authoritative source for all URN assignments under both the "mef" and "mplify" namespaces.

ul.li: This is the initial registration; no prior versions exist.

section.title: IANA Considerations
section.t: This document adds a new entry ("mplify") in the urn-namespace registry. This is the defining document. When published, the entry can be found in the "Uniform Resource Names (URN) Namespaces" registry available from the IANA site (https://www.iana.org) and any associated mirrors.
